title: Operation outcome
description: The outcome the add-on reports for an operation it ran. succeeded: it acted. no_change (feature calls): the state was already as asked, so nothing was written and log_records is unchanged (an item the subject already holds). A refusal (someone else holds it) is never an outcome: it is a problem+json 4xx. The backend's own transport outcomes (rejected, unreached, indeterminate) are derived from what happens to the call and never appear on the wire.
